title: DecisionReceiptRequest
description:
2026-09-30: a signed, salted commitment to a bounded-choice decision (OpenAI Decisions API, Jev, our
/decision, any classifier), gated on a /review proof for the options marked irreversible. Only hashes and
a salted choice commitment are signed; the salt is returned to the caller alone. Validation lives in
services/decision_receipt.validate so REST and MCP share it.

options.title: Options
options.description: The fixed answer options (2-64 distinct strings).

choice.title: Choice
choice.description: The option the decider returned; must be one of options.

irreversible_options.title: Irreversible Options
irreversible_options.description: Options that need a /review proof before they are executable.

context.title: Context
context.description: The input the decision was made on. Hashed here and discarded, never stored.

context_sha256.title: Context Sha256
context_sha256.description: Alternatively, sha256 hex of that input, hashed on your side.

decider.title: Decider
decider.description: {provider, model, request_id}: caller-reported; request_id is stored only as a hash.

review_proof.title: Review Proof
review_proof.description: For a gated choice: the signed event from /review(sign=true) whose artifact is the same bytes as context.

salt.title: Salt
salt.description: Decider-scoped receipts only: the decider's 32-byte salt (64 hex) used for the commitments it signs.

decider_sig.title: Decider Sig
decider_sig.description: Decider-scoped receipts only: BIP-340 signature by decider.pubkey over sha256(JCS(decision claim)); see SPEC v0.4.

decider_claimed_at.title: Decider Claimed At
decider_claimed_at.description: Decider-scoped receipts only: the unix time in the signed claim (within 600 s of now).
